exposure: Transabdominal ultrasound-guided suction curettage + Foley balloon as first-line treatment for CSP
cohort: 42 patients diagnosed with CSP between January 2015 and April 2019 who underwent transabdominal ultrasound-guided suction curettage + Foley balloon treatment.
finding: Suction curettage + Foley balloon treatment for CSP was found to be a highly successful, minimally invasive method with positive effects on future fertility outcomes.
mod_finding: 8 out of 12 patients who conceived after the treatment had a caesarean delivery at full term.
